source.snippet: I maintain a set of REST microservices (Go and Node.js, running in Docker on Linux) and our API regression suite is mostly hand-written Postman collections. Keeping them updated as endpoints takes too much time, and our mocks for downstream services (Postgres, Redis, a couple of third-party APIs) drift from real behaviour. I'm looking for a tool that can: Generate API test cases automatically, ideally by recording real requests/responses rather than me writing each assertion. Create mocks/stubs...

problem_statement: Engineering teams maintaining REST microservices spend excessive time hand-writing and updating API regression tests and mocks; as endpoints evolve, hand-crafted Postman collections drift from real service behavior, causing test gaps and wasted developer hours.
target_segment: Backend engineers and DevOps teams at small-to-mid-size SaaS companies running microservice architectures on Linux/Docker with CI pipelines.
notes: Poster is in a clear business/work context (maintaining production microservices, Docker, CI). Pain is explicit: 'takes too much time', mocks 'drift from real behaviour'. Tool-seeking behavior with detailed requirements suggests active evaluation and budget readiness. Existing paid competitors (Keploy, Speedscale, Hoverfly) confirm market exists. Buyer: engineering team with tooling budget.
